name: display-switch
title: Display Switch
description: Toggle a display between extended and mirrored in one keystroke, straight from Raycast.
author: lucas

commands.name: toggle-mirror
commands.title: Toggle Mirror
commands.description: Flip between mirrored and extended. Bind this to a global hotkey.

commands.name: mirror
commands.title: Mirror Displays
commands.description: Mirror every display to the one chosen in preferences. Does nothing if already mirrored.

commands.name: extend
commands.title: Extend Displays
commands.description: Stop mirroring and put the menu bar back on the preferred main display. Does nothing if already extended.

commands.name: swap-main
commands.title: Swap Main Display
commands.description: Move the menu bar to the other display without changing mirroring.

commands.name: displays
commands.title: Manage Displays
commands.description: List every connected display and set it to mirror, extend, or become the main display.

commands.name: display-status
commands.title: Display Status
commands.description: Menu bar item showing whether displays are mirrored or extended, with one-click switching.

preferences.name: mirrorOptimizeFor
preferences.title: Mirror Optimized For
preferences.description: Which display the others copy when mirroring. It also sets the resolution used while mirrored. External keeps the big screen sharp; Built-in behaves like macOS's ⌘F1 shortcut.

preferences.name: mainWhenExtended
preferences.title: Main Display When Extended
preferences.description: Where the menu bar goes after Extend Displays. macOS usually restores it, but not always after sleep or replugging.

preferences.name: showHUD
preferences.title: Feedback
preferences.label: Show a HUD after switching
preferences.description: Show a short on-screen line describing the resulting state.

preferences.name: audioFollowsMain
preferences.title: Audio
preferences.label: Audio output follows the main display
preferences.description: When Swap Main Display moves the menu bar, also route sound to that display's speakers (or the built-in speakers).

preferences.name: dimBuiltinWhileMirrored
preferences.title: Brightness
preferences.label: Dim the built-in display while mirrored
preferences.description: Mirror Displays turns the built-in display's brightness down; Extend Displays restores it. Useful when watching the big screen.

preferences.name: autoExtend
preferences.title: Auto-Extend
preferences.label: Undo mirroring that macOS turns on by itself
preferences.description: Display Status checks about once a minute (needs Background Refresh on that command). If displays are mirrored and this extension did not do it, it extends them. Mirroring set through ⌘F1 or System Settings will be undone too.

scripts.clean: rm -rf dist compiled_raycast_swift raycast-env.d.ts swift/.build swift/.swiftpm swift/.raycast-swift-build
scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

This is a Raycast extension, not an npm package. Use 'npm run publish'.

" && exit 1
